errors.evidence: The description states that the countries on the horizontal axis are arranged in alphabetical order, but they are actually arranged in ascending order of the total height of the bars (total energy cost).

errors.text_span: Всеки стълб е групиран и съдържа натрупани сегменти
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars are grouped and stacked, but they are only stacked.

errors.text_span: оранжеви диамантовидни маркери, които показват средното процентно участие на разходите за енергия в общите разходи за домакинствата (avg.)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the orange diamond markers represent an average value (avg.). The legend indicates that these markers show the 'Share of energy for households (right axis)' for each respective country. The 'avg.' label on the x-axis denotes the EU average category, which is a separate data point.

When describing the data for Denmark (DK), the description states that energy costs constitute about 20% of total costs. The orange marker for DK on the chart is at approximately 10% on the right y-axis.

When describing the data for Latvia (LV), the description states that energy costs constitute about 5% of total costs. The orange marker for LV on the chart is at approximately 14.5% on the right y-axis.

errors.text_span: енергия за отопление (син), твърди горива (лилав), течни горива (зелен), природен газ (червен) и електроенергия (тъмносин)
errors.evidence: The description lists the components of the stacked bars in the order they appear in the legend, not in the actual stacking order (e.g., bottom-to-top or top-to-bottom). This makes it difficult to understand the composition of the bars, as the first item listed ('енергия за отопление') is the top segment and the last item listed ('електроенергия') is the bottom segment.
